text: Which dispenser would you choose? Part two! These are even harder. Three seconds each!
Round one! Buttery popcorn... or crispy fries?
Round two! Hot dogs... or burgers?
Round three! A chocolate milkshake... or hot chocolate?
Round four! Chocolate cake... or cupcakes?
Round five! Juicy watermelon... or ice cream?
Final round! A thousand dollars, right now... or free pizza, for the rest of your life?
Comment your picks! And tell me what part three should be!
